# Joshua Werlein

> Full stack software engineer based in Mondovi, Wisconsin. Building production Android apps, serverless APIs, and modern web platforms with a focus on ownership from first commit to live deployment. Open to remote opportunities.

I hold a B.S. in Software Engineering from Western Governors University and work across the full stack — TypeScript and React on the frontend, Cloudflare Workers with D1, KV, and R2 for edge platforms, and Java for native Android applications.

## Featured Projects

- [Grayz'n Buffalo Bar & Grill](https://grayznbuffalo.com): Production restaurant platform built with Astro and Cloudflare Workers/Pages. Uses D1, KV, and R2 for menu content, recurring weekly specials, sessions, and managed media; includes a scheduled Facebook Graph Worker with cached, last-known-good feed behavior and Turnstile/Resend contact handling. Source: [github.com/joshua-werlein/grayzn-buffalo](https://github.com/joshua-werlein/grayzn-buffalo).

- [Arkham Enterprises](https://www.arkhamsolar.com): Live production marketing and lead-gen site for a solar and construction company. React SPA served from a Cloudflare Worker with multi-step quote-request forms, Resend delivery, deep-linked service context, structured metadata, and accessibility-focused routing. Source: [github.com/joshua-werlein/arkham-solar](https://github.com/joshua-werlein/arkham-solar).

- [Best By Manager](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bestbymanager.app): Published Android inventory app for shared-device retail and food-service workflows. Uses Room/SQLite, ZXing barcode scanning, local expiration alerts, and Owner/Admin/Employee access controls. Source: [github.com/joshua-werlein/BestByManager](https://github.com/joshua-werlein/BestByManager).

- [KIL Construction](https://kilcon.work): Production Astro/Cloudflare platform with R2-backed project media, review moderation, secured admin tooling, and Worker-backed business workflows. Source: [github.com/joshua-werlein/kilConstruction](https://github.com/joshua-werlein/kilConstruction).

- [Friends of Lake Henry](https://friendsoflakehenry.com): Production nonprofit platform using Astro and Cloudflare services for events, raffle operations, donor recognition, and moderated community photo submissions. Source: [github.com/joshua-werlein/friends-of-lake-henry](https://github.com/joshua-werlein/friends-of-lake-henry).

- [Blair Sportsmen's Club](https://blairsportsmensclub.com): Event and reservation platform with a D1-backed availability calendar, reservation requests, magic-link administration, and trap-league scoring.
